languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Destroy robots: their wreckage becomes climbable scrap.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Destrueix robots: les seves restes es converteixen en ferralla escalable.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>A very uneven heap occasionally attracts a bulky junk drop.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Una pila molt desnivellada atrau ocasionalment una gran càrrega de ferralla.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green>Build and climb onto settled scrap at %1 m.</green>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green>Construeix i puja sobre ferralla assentada a %1 m.</green>
[minimsg]<green>Ferralla</green>
[minimsg]<gold>Objectiu</gold>
[minimsg]<aqua>Onada</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Incoming junk! It will settle into a low part of the heap.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Arriba ferralla! S'assentarà en una zona baixa de la pila.</gold>
[minimsg]<green><bold>L'equip ha arribat als %1 m!</bold></green>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Right-click the Taser to toggle chain lightning; switch to your sword while it recharges.</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Fes clic dret amb el Taser per activar els llamps; canvia a l’espasa mentre es recarrega.</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<yellow>Between waves, collect your glowing supplies at the center: Taser cores, equipment, TNT and scaffolds.</yellow>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<yellow>Entre onades, recull els teus subministraments brillants al centre: nuclis de Taser, equipament, TNT i bastides.</yellow>
[minimsg]<red><bold>Onada %1:</bold></red> <white>arriben %2 robots.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<green><bold>Wave %1 cleared!</bold></green> <yellow>Supplies are falling at the center. Wave resumes in %2 s.</yellow>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<green><bold>Onada %1 superada!</bold></green> <yellow>Cauen subministraments al centre. L'onada torna en %2 s.</yellow>
[minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser</bold></aqua>
[minimsg]<gray>Clic dret per connectar automàticament els robots propers.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>More charge supports more targets; it recharges while carried.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Més càrrega permet més objectius; es recarrega mentre el portes.</gray>
[minimsg]<aqua>Taser N%1: %2/%3</aqua>
[minimsg]<yellow>Taser N%1 actiu: %2/%3</yellow>
[minimsg]<aqua><bold>Nucli de Taser</bold></aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Pick up to upgrade your Taser's charge, chaining, and recharge.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Recull-lo per millorar la càrrega, els enllaços i la recàrrega del Taser.</gray>
[minimsg]<aqua><bold>Taser millorat al nivell %1.</bold></aqua>
[minimsg]<gray>El teu Taser ja està millorat al màxim.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gold>Place TNT and light it with flint and steel: it blasts robots and lifts everyone nearby without hurting players.</gold>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gold>Posa TNT i encén-la amb l’encenedor: destrossa robots i aixeca tothom a prop sense fer mal als jugadors.</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Too much TNT deployed. Recover or detonate a charge first.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Hi ha massa TNT desplegada. Recupera o fes explotar una càrrega abans.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Stop its saw with the Taser, or leave the scaffold before it cuts.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Atura la serra amb el Taser o abandona la bastida abans que la talli.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Jump over its slam; attack when its armor opens or interrupt with the Taser.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Salta per evitar el cop; ataca quan obri l’armadura o interromp-lo amb el Taser.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Wave %1: the Compactor! Watch for yellow warnings; attack when the bar turns green.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Onada %1: el Compactador! Vigila els avisos grocs; ataca quan la barra es torni verda.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>The Compactor is overheating! Attacks come faster; warning time stays the same.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>El Compactador se sobreescalfa! Ataca més sovint; el temps d’avís és el mateix.</white>
[minimsg]<white>Compactador • Blindat</white>
[minimsg]<white>Compactador • COP A TERRA — Salta!</white>
[minimsg]<white>Compactador • LLANÇAMENT — Esquiva!</white>
[minimsg]<white>Compactador • VULNERABLE — Ataca!</white>
[minimsg]<white>Compactador • Sobreescalfat</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>You have 3 lives; keep your gear on respawn, spectate at zero. The team loses when everyone is out.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Tens 3 vides; conserves l’equip en reaparèixer i observes quan s’acaben. L’equip perd quan no queda ningú.</white>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<aqua>Right-click the Jetpack feather to toggle thrust; switch items to stop, and land to recharge.</aqua>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<aqua>Fes clic dret amb la ploma de propulsió per volar; canvia d’objecte per parar i aterra per recarregar.</aqua>
[minimsg]<aqua>Vides</aqua>
[minimsg]<aqua>Propera onada en</aqua>
[minimsg]<aqua>Robots restants</aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<yellow>Lives: %1. Respawn with your equipment and keep climbing.</yellow>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<yellow>Vides: %1. Reapareix amb el teu equip i continua pujant.</yellow>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<red>Lives: %1. You are now spectating; your teammates can still finish the climb.</red>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<red>Vides: %1. Ara observes; els teus companys encara poden completar l’ascens.</red>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<red><bold>The team is out of lives.</bold></red> <white>The climb ends here.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<red><bold>L’equip s’ha quedat sense vides.</bold></red> <white>L’ascens acaba aquí.</white>
[minimsg]<gold>Treballador</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Slash it with your sword; its wreckage becomes climbing terrain.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Ataca’l amb l’espasa; les restes es converteixen en terreny escalable.</white>
[minimsg]<gold>Guàrdia</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>This skeleton carries a sword; keep moving and use the Taser for groups.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Aquest esquelet porta espasa; mou-te i usa el Taser contra els grups.</white>
[minimsg]<gold>Saltador</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Its springs wind up before a hop; dodge sideways or stop it with the Taser.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Prepara les molles abans de saltar; esquiva’l de costat o atura’l amb el Taser.</white>
[minimsg]<gold>Tallador</gold>
[minimsg]<gold>Dron daurat</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>It throws fire; connect your Taser to stop its shots.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Llança foc; connecta-hi el Taser per aturar els trets.</white>
[minimsg]<gold>Artilleria de ferro</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Dodge its iron shots, then use your bow or Taser to bring it down.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>Esquiva els trets de ferro i abat-lo amb l’arc o el Taser.</white>
[minimsg]<gold>Compactador</gold>
[minimsg]<gold>Pesant</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Its iron head resists hits; use TNT or land a sword critical for extra scrap.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>El cap de ferro resisteix cops; usa TNT o fes un crític per obtenir més ferralla.</white>
[minimsg]<gold>Accelerat</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Its redstone head makes it fast; slow it down with the Taser.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>El cap de redstone el fa ràpid; frena’l amb el Taser.</white>
[minimsg]<gold>Explorador</gold>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<white>Its lapis head marks an agile guard; keep it away from your scaffolds.</white>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<white>El cap de lapislàtzuli marca un guàrdia àgil; allunya’l de les bastides.</white>
[minimsg]<aqua><bold>Propulsor</bold></aqua>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Right-click to toggle thrust; switch items to stop.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Clic dret per volar; canvia d’objecte per parar.</gray>

languages.en_US: [minimsg]<gray>Three seconds of flight; land to recharge.</gray>
languages.ca_ES: [minimsg]<gray>Tres segons de vol; aterra per recarregar.</gray>
[minimsg]<aqua>Propulsor actiu: %1/%2</aqua>
[minimsg]<aqua>Propulsor: %1/%2</aqua>
